```text
# PR #4882: Patch: an AI deck that leans on no set keeps its Units floor when its theme has few or no Units

Closes #4784

A deck that leans on no set now always holds both its Units floor and its theme's floor whenever the cards left allow it, as SPEC §9.9 and R1370 already said. Only the decks that missed the Units floor before are dealt differently; every other deck, and every rng cursor, stays as it was.

**The cause.** When a deck has no lean set, `narrow_unleaned` narrows the draw to Units without counting the theme cards still owed. A theme with few or no Units then took the last slots and the deck came up short. Book, Fruit, Drone Core, Jelly Bean, Mineral and Call to Chaos hold no Units; KY holds 3 of 15 and Terminus 1 of 6. I checked these counts against `catalog.json`.

## What changed

- **`crates/ai/src/deck.rs`**
  - Each pick is still drawn as before, from one `rng.next()`, out of `narrow_unleaned`'s cards. `narrow_unleaned` itself is unchanged.
  - In a themed deck with no lean, a new `unleaned_redraw` then asks R1370's floor solver whether the card drawn still leaves both floors reachable. The solver is `narrow_leaning`'s old body, moved into a new `floor_takes` that returns the kinds of card it keeps.
  - When the card would cost a floor, the pick is drawn again with **the same roll** and the same weights. It comes from the narrowed cards the solver keeps, or from every remaining card it keeps when none of the narrowed cards qualify.
  - `weighted_index` now takes the roll instead of the rng. `narrow_leaning` returns exactly what it did before.
- **`crates/ai/tests/ai/deck.rs`**
  - `every_floor_holds` takes `Option<SetName>`. The seed label is byte-identical for every existing leaning call, so no existing seed moves.
  - A fifth pin: a Book-themed 25-card deck that held the floor on `main`.
  - Four `r4784000_*` tests, each checking every deck rather than an average:
    - every theme tag at every tier;
    - a rolled theme or none, for the AI's pool and a player's;
    - every quality-gate deck in the full run, live and fixture pool, both seats;
    - 200 Book seeds, with the rng cursor checked.
- **Spec**
  - New ruling `spec/rulings/R4784000.md`, with its §11 paragraph in `spec/pending/4784.md`.
  - R1370's last paragraph is amended; it said no deck without a lean set would ever move.
  - One sentence added to §9.9's Decks bullet.
- **Docs:** `crates/ai/README.md` and the `build_ai_deck` comment in `docs/v0.3.0/SURFACE.md`.

## What moves

I measured this with a throwaway test that is not in the diff. It printed every deck dealt by the base `deck.rs` and by this one, and I compared the two lists. It covered 24,600 decks with no lean set:

- 9,000 of the AI's own default decks (3,000 per tier, theme rolled);
- 3,000 player random decks;
- 10,800 decks with each of the 18 theme tags set, at 25, 30 and 35 cards;
- 1,800 gate, fixture and tuning decks (100 games a matchup, both seats).

Results:

- **Short decks:** 1,308 held fewer Units than the floor on `main`, 260 of them among the AI's own 9,000 default decks. All 1,308 are dealt again and now hold it.
- **Everything else:** no other deck changed and no rng cursor moved.
- **Small themes:** themes with fewer cards than their floor (Terminus 6, Jelly Bean, Mineral and Call to Chaos 7, Catalyst 8, Drone Core 10 at 35 cards) still put every card of the theme in the deck, before and after.
- **`gate:v3` full run: 16 decks are dealt again.**
  - ai-vs-random 4, 7, 52, 78, 82;
  - ai-vs-greedy 9, 12, 19, 22 (both seats), 24, 37, 50;
  - hard-vs-easy 5, 13, 33.

  This matches the plan's list.
- **R4513000's tuning games** (50 a matchup): one deck in each of 12 games changes. I did not re-measure the gate rates.
- **Pins: none of the 4 existing pins moved.** The pin test, with the Book pin added, passes before and after the fix.
- **e2e:** none of the practice decks the specs use changes. I checked the AI and player decks for `13-practice-z`, `13-practice-t:replay`, `13-practice-t:reload`, `13-practice-t:save`, `13-practice:hard`, `17-showcase` and `38-accessibility`.
- **Web unit tests:** two seeds now deal different decks, `wasm-index` (`src/wasm/index.test.ts`) and `ai-deck-seed` (`src/wire/ai.test.ts`). Neither test depends on which cards are dealt: they only check a deal equals itself, its length, and whatever card is first in the library. I did not run the web suite.

- **The new tests against the old code:** `cargo test -p jackioh-ai --test ai deck::r1370_a_deck_that_leans_on_a_set::` on the unchanged `deck.rs`. The four `r4784000_*` tests failed (for example "gate:v3:ai-vs-random:4 p1: 10 units of 25, the floor is 12" and "{"manaCap":4,"theme":"Book"} seed 2"), and the 5-pin test passed.
- **After the fix:**
  - `cargo test -p jackioh-ai --test ai deck::`: 60 passed.
  - `cargo test --workspace --features jackioh-engine/testkit,jackioh-engine/ts`: exit 0, 23,826 passed, 0 failed, including `ai_slow` and the per-PR gate smoke `b28_b31`. `git status --porcelain -- apps/web/src/wire` is empty.
- **Daily tests the fix could affect:**
  - `cargo test -p jackioh-tools --features jackioh-engine/testkit,jackioh-engine/ts --bins -- --ignored b29_b31 b30_b31`: 2 passed.
  - `cargo test -p jackioh-ai --test ai_slow r186_giga_glowy -- --ignored`: 1 passed.
- **Checks:**
  - `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo clippy -p jackioh-ai --all-targets -- -D warnings` are clean.
  - `cargo jackioh spec check`: "2564 rulings, 6357 proofs, 77761 citations in 5016 files, 35045 links: ok".
  - `patches check` and `catalog check` pass.

- **Redraw with the same roll, not a combined narrowing through `narrow_leaning`.** A combined narrowing would also change decks that hold both floors today. The issue asked for a fix that moves only the short decks, and this one does.
- **No extra rng draw.** A second `rng.next()` would shift the cursor and everything dealt after it.
- **Nothing re-pinned.** No existing pin changed, so there was nothing to re-pin. I added one Book pin so a theme with no Units is pinned.

- **The §9.9 sentence is in `spec/09-architecture/9.9-practice-ai.md`.** The spec was split into smaller notes after the plan was written.
- **The ruling and the pending paragraph use my numbers, not the planner's.** The planner's prototype covered 29,700 decks with 1,779 short; I could only report what I ran myself. The two agree where they overlap: the same 16 gate decks move, no cursor moves, and no pin moves.
- **`floor_takes` counts the kinds of card directly** instead of first building the list that only the old filter used. Its output is the same.

## Worth a second look

- In `unleaned_redraw`, when none of the narrowed cards qualify, the redraw falls back to all remaining cards. That fallback is what keeps the theme's floor first when the slots can't hold both. An example is a narrowing down to Units while the theme, which has no Units, still owes cards.
```

````text
# #4784: Patch: an AI deck that leans on no set keeps its Units floor when its theme has few or no Units
Opened by @squishy-squooby.

### What happens

`build_ai_deck` deals decks below the Units floor whenever the rolled theme is a tag with few or no Units. About 4.5% of default Easy decks are short, some of the quality gates' own decks among them.

The cause is `narrow_unleaned` (`crates/ai/src/deck.rs:410-437`, called at `deck.rs:745`). It restricts the draw to Units only once `units_needed - tally.units >= slots_left`, and never counts the slots the theme still owes. With a theme whose cards are mostly not Units, the theme's narrowing takes the last slots, the Units filter finds none among the theme's cards (`unit_cards.is_empty()`), and the Units still owed are never made up.

Measured on today's pool (799 cards):

- Theme tags with too few Units, as (cards, Units): Book (16, 0), Fruit (16, 0), Drone Core (10, 0), Jelly Bean (7, 0), Mineral (7, 0), Call to Chaos (7, 0), KY (15, 3), Terminus (6, 1). That is 8 of the 18 tags a theme can roll.
- An explicit theme, 2,000 seeds each at 25 cards (floor 12): Book misses 862 times, Drone Core 945, Fruit 907, Jelly Bean 554, Mineral 555, Call to Chaos 557, KY 97, Terminus 102. Sizes 30 and 35 miss too.
- Default options (the theme rolled, only `mana_cap` set, as the gates deal), 5,000 seeds each: Easy (25 cards, floor 12) misses 224 times, Medium (30, floor 14) 129, Hard (35, floor 16) 77.
- Shipped gate decks (`game_config(…, "gate:v3")`) below the floor: ai-vs-greedy game 9 p1 holds 8 Units of 25; games 37 and 50 p2 hold 9; ai-vs-random game 7 p1 holds 9; hard-vs-easy game 5 p1 holds 13 of 35 (floor 16).

The theme's own floor never missed in any of these runs. The leaning path (`narrow_leaning`) keeps all three floors and is not affected.

### What should happen

Every deck holds at least `ceil(size × AI_DECK.min_unit_share)` Units, whenever the cards left can meet the floors together. A themed 25-card deck owes 8 theme cards and 12 Units, which fit, so the floor is reachable.

- SPEC §9.9, Decks (`spec/09-architecture.md`): "`AI_DECK.leanMinShare`, a hard floor beside the units' and the theme's, all three kept together".
- R1370: "It is a hard floor, as the theme's `themeMinShare` and the units' `minUnitShare` are, so it holds whatever the rng does."
- `crates/ai/src/deck.rs:5-7`: "The floors are hard rather than weighted … so a themed deck meets `themeMinShare`, every deck `minUnitShare`".

### How to reproduce

Both tests fail on `main` (3a83bd7). They are also on branch `claude/vigilant-mayer-pmyrhr`, `crates/ai/tests/audit_decks.rs`.

```rust
use jackioh_ai::{AI_DECK, AI_GATE, AI_GATE_BUDGET, AiDeckOptions, Matchup, build_ai_deck, game_config};
use jackioh_engine::testkit::{CardType, create_rng, def_of, json, json_as};

fn units_in(deck: &[String]) -> usize {
    deck.iter().filter(|id| def_of(None, id).type_ == CardType::Unit).count()
}
/// ceil(size × minUnitShare), as `build_ai_deck_traced` rounds it.
fn units_needed(size: usize) -> usize {
    (size as f64 * AI_DECK.min_unit_share).ceil() as usize
}

#[test]
fn the_quality_gates_own_ai_deck_holds_the_units_floor() {
    jackioh_cards::register_all();
    let config = game_config(Matchup::AiVsGreedy, 9, AI_GATE_BUDGET, AI_GATE.seed_series);
    let deck = &config.decks.0;
    assert!(units_in(deck) >= units_needed(deck.len()),
        "gate ai-vs-greedy game 9, p1: {} Units of {}, the floor is {}: {deck:?}",
        units_in(deck), deck.len(), units_needed(deck.len()));
}

#[test]
fn a_deck_themed_on_a_tag_with_no_units_holds_the_units_floor() {
    jackioh_cards::register_all();
    let opts: AiDeckOptions = json_as(json!({ "theme": "Book" }));
    let short: Vec<String> = (1..=200).filter_map(|n| {
        let seed = format!("audit:25:Book:{n}");
        let deck = build_ai_deck(&mut create_rng(&seed, 0), 25, &opts);
        (units_in(&deck) < units_needed(25)).then(|| format!("{seed}: {} Units", units_in(&deck)))
    }).collect();
    assert!(short.is_empty(), "{} of 200 Book-themed 25-card decks hold fewer than {} Units, e.g. {:?}",
        short.len(), units_needed(25), &short[..short.len().min(3)]);
}
```

Output today:

```
gate ai-vs-greedy game 9, p1: 8 Units of 25, the floor is 12: ["stinkyscape-009", "classic-005", …]
80 of 200 Book-themed 25-card decks hold fewer than 12 Units, e.g. ["audit:25:Book:4: 10 Units", "audit:25:Book:8: 11 Units", "audit:25:Book:12: 11 Units"]
```

### Where

The AI: `crates/ai/src/deck.rs`, `narrow_unleaned`.

### Version or commit

`main` at 3a83bd7.

### Notes for the fix

- The simplest sound fix is to narrow on the theme's and the Units' floors jointly in the unleaned path, as `min_slots` / `narrow_leaning` already do for a leaning deck (with no lean, theme before Units when both cannot hold).
- **This re-deals some seeds, and R1370 said none would move.** R1370's last paragraph: "Without `leanSet` the draw is the one it always was … every seed deals the deck it dealt before this ruling, so no golden trace, seed-pinned test or replay moves." The fix needs a ruling note in this issue's block that amends that paragraph, and a decision on what is re-pinned. Prefer a fix that moves only the seeds whose decks miss the floor today, if one exists; say in the pull request how many of the pinned seeds moved.
- What pins today's deals and will need a look: `r1370_without_a_lean_set_these_seeds_deal_the_decks_they_always_did_and_take_no_extra_rng_draw` (`crates/ai/tests/ai/deck.rs`), the `gate:v3` decks and the gate floors measured on them (#4513), the seeded practice fixtures and named practice seeds (`FIXTURE_BANNED_IDS`: a fixture that needs a new deal changes its seed), and any e2e spec that reads a dealt AI deck.
- The existing test `units_hold_their_share` checks the Units share only as a mean over 200 seeds, which is why this went unseen; the per-deck check `every_floor_holds` runs only with `leanSet`. Add the per-deck check for unleaned decks, over every theme tag.
- Not the Quickdraw cap (R817000): none of the eight tags is Quickdraw.

Found by an audit of the AI crate; the reproduction was run and the code path read before filing.
````
